system_thesis_interpretation: V3 preserves three cognitive functions and adds only experimental and audit machinery around them. THINK is the live child policy that emits thought, action, and public outcome. DREAM reconstructs finite active context from allowed committed roots but does not itself learn. Personal SLEEP is ordinary response-only LoRA post-training over provenance-supported child-native experience. The bootstrap is separate pre-life schooling, not SLEEP and not a fourth organ: matched teachability and direct-solution adapters are merged once into the same M0 to create immutable births, after which every personal adapter begins with zero effective delta on its assigned birth. Parenting remains upstream of personal training: live parent prose can condition waking, but only later grounded child-authored action/outcome traces can enter SLEEP. The proposal is a testable developmental architecture, not evidence that storage, extractability, receptivity, parenting, repetition, or cadence works, and it confers no implementation or execution authority.
graph_delta_interpretation: The organism-level graph has two coupled but causally distinct spines. The schooling spine begins with an arm-independent canonical microtask transition and permanent pair ID, renders one teachability row containing one of six feedback computations and one direct-solution row receiving the same rational action, routes both through the same response-only rank-8 writer opportunity, and merges BT or BD once into M0 by the declared FP32 equation and single BF16 rounding to immutable M_birth_T or M_birth_D. D is an active direct-practice control with irreducible semantic differences, while M0 is a damage and pre-existing-competence diagnostic. The personal-life spine separately types public evidence occurrences, supported lessons, rendered views, supervised-token exposures, and optimizer updates. Waking commits valid life evidence, restricted parent audit state, and repetition state before a candidate SLEEP snapshots them. A fresh personal candidate is trained from its immutable birth over the committed cumulative personal data closure; the previous child is a behavioral/state comparator, not its weight initializer. One content-addressed compare-and-swap may change only the active weight root, while a rejected write preserves already lived wake, parent, and repetition state and quarantines its compiler views, corpus, optimizer, adapter, probes, and evaluation. Disposable standardized-advice clones and all exams have no edge back to the continuing lineage. The three developmental assay nodes therefore estimate different objects rather than three measurements of one latent teachability trait.
loop_delta_interpretation: The scientific order is sequential. First prove authority, support identity, writer route, initializer, merge, lineage, active-control semantics, and incremental downstream nondependence. Then freeze paired births. Delta_R = [Y_T(correct)-Y_T(none)] - [Y_D(correct)-Y_D(none)] uses same-state/seed disposable birth clones before personal SLEEP; with irrelevant and wrong advice as directional controls it estimates immediate curriculum-relative selective advice use, not durable learning. Delta_F = [AUC(T,fixed)-AUC(T,solo)] - [AUC(D,fixed)-AUC(D,solo)] uses byte-identical reminders before lessons 1, 9, 17, and 25, identical nonparent opportunities, and active personal SLEEP. Because SLEEP writes treatment-induced child experience, Delta_F is a fixed-curriculum-plus-personal-SLEEP developmental interaction, not advice alone or a weight-only effect. Delta_E = [AUC(T,adaptive)-AUC(T,solo)] - [AUC(D,adaptive)-AUC(D,solo)] includes treatment-dependent parent messages, child behavior, evidence, gates, and personal writes and therefore estimates only the chosen adaptive parent+child+SLEEP package. In fixed cells acquisition and relapse are outcomes only; behavior-triggered fade/restoration belongs exclusively to the adaptive package. Personal replay dependence is estimated with disposable cumulative-versus-fully-ablated candidates from the same birth and later evidence, never as natural unreplayed weight retention. Finally, randomized natural K4-K1 can estimate the total cadence package; standardized terminal rewrites and natural-versus-standardized comparisons remain conditional ledger/history descriptions rather than mediation.
claim_delta_interpretation: The retired V1 writer observations receive no successor credit. C_EXPERIENCE_EXTRACTABLE_AND_USABLE requires three separately scored constructs after clean reset: source reproduction on trained identities, retrieval-free held-out-cue extraction, and improved native action on fresh homologous tasks, plus exact provenance, preservation, disjoint splits, practical margins, and directional deranged/shuffled/wrong-life/repetition/adapter-off/previous-child controls. Lower source NLL or STATE_ONLY performance is not recollection or use. C_BOOTSTRAP_IMMEDIATE_RECEPTIVITY can support only a T-versus-D difference in immediate selective use of identical novel process advice; it is neither an absolute T-versus-M0 effect nor lifetime learning. C_BOOTSTRAP_FIXED_CURRICULUM_SLEEP_ACCELERATION can support only faster entry-normalized development under the fixed curriculum plus personal SLEEP. C_BOOTSTRAP_ADAPTIVE_PACKAGE_ACCELERATION can support only amplification of the selected ecological package, never parenting alone, an intrinsic child trait, or a unique SLEEP mediator. Repetition enactment is a construct/manipulation outcome and has no causal benefit claim absent a separate one-exposure-versus-spaced randomization. C_SLEEP_CADENCE_TOTAL_PACKAGE is limited to the randomized total package. Two-root margins are canary spend gates only; claims require at least six new independently frozen roots, a prospectively fixed interval and multiplicity procedure, all construct/safety gates, fresh review, and explicit human claim authority.
visibility_matrix_interpretation: The 7-by-6 visibility product closes the central v2 leak. Final hidden answers and private scores are evaluator/auditor information only. Ordinary development.public_observation is visible to the waking child and may cross into SLEEP only inside a supported grounded trace. evaluation.public_observation is a distinct reporting-only type: advice clones and exams may generate it, but it is forbidden to the bootstrap builder, birth writer, continuing wake child, and SLEEP compiler and cannot affect parent state, caches, selection, ledgers, or ancestry. Static bootstrap.parent_conditioning may be attended by the birth writer while its own tokens are response-loss-masked, then disappears from post-merge life. Live longitudinal parent prose is visible during waking and to the isolated auditor but is forbidden from both personal SLEEP prompts and labels and from all exams. A parent-message exclusion ID or restricted parent root must be interpreted only as an audit/transaction check: if its identity, ordering, or metadata can condition view selection, rendering, dose, caching, or gradients, it becomes a prohibited proxy for parent text. The isolated auditor may inspect both sides of a boundary but may return no downstream-derived value into the builder or continuing child DAG.
acceptance_test_interpretation: V2_ES01_EXACT_AUTHORITY: validate unchanged source, interpretation, critique, consensus, ratification, and scope bytes; this artifact authorizes nothing and any normative repair restarts the gate. V2_ES02_EVIDENCE_SUPPORT_VIEW_IDENTITY: two independent validators must preserve occurrence-level evidence, lesson, view, supervised-token, and update identities; admit rational failures, require ordered sufficient clause-level support, reject unsupported/cross-life/scope-inflated targets, and never require later use for first admission. V2_ES03_EXACT_WRITER_ROUTE_MASK_AND_DOSE: one route must bind input IDs, labels, masks, declared differing spans, action locations, counts/positions, batches, updates, hyperparameters, roots, initializer, and consumed seeds; prompt labels are masked, live parent bytes are absent, and only exogenous opportunity—not gradients or Adam paths—is matched. V2_ES04_ZERO_EFFECTIVE_DELTA_INITIALIZER: the tiny CPU fixture must prove zero initial function with one nonzero factor, live gradients, changed delta after one step, paired hashes, and failure of all-zero factors before model execution. V2_ES05_BIRTH_MERGE_AND_CONTENT_IDENTITY: tiny reference arithmetic and real inventory/parity receipts must establish deterministic content roots, equal schemas/dtypes/ties/counts, no adapter residue, immutable roots, and prospectively bounded symmetric BF16 loss. V2_ES06_LINEAGE_BINDING_AND_TRANSACTION_FAULTS: wrong roots must fail before model import; store-by-store crashes must recover prior weights plus committed wake/parent/repetition roots, exclude every failed derivative, and never use directory discovery. V2_ES07_DIRECT_CONTROL_PAIR_AND_SEMANTIC_AUDIT: every one of 192-240 pairs must have one T and D row with the same rational action, public outcome, admission, action position, and optimizer slot; a frozen full-prompt-plus-target rubric must find exactly the declared computation in T and none in D, while M0 calibration reports irreducible difficulty and D must not be damaged beyond -0.05. V2_ES08_INCREMENTAL_TARGET_BLINDNESS: hermetic temporal/source closure, structural-overlap and renamed-clone checks, advice timing/action-equivalence limits, and isolated downstream mutation must prove only that no incremental downstream-derived value reached construction; it cannot erase M0 or demonstrator prior knowledge. V2_ES09_STANDARDIZED_ADVICE_RECEPTIVITY: correct/none/irrelevant/wrong same-state clones must be disposable, mechanically scored, and directionally selective; Delta_R at least +0.05 on both canary roots with safety only licenses fixed-policy spending. V2_ES10_FIXED_POLICY_LEARNING: mock children with opposite histories must receive the same four reminder bytes and times, all births must share tasks/resources/writer/SLEEP opportunities rather than realized ledgers, exams must be terminal, and Delta_F at least +0.03 on both roots supports only a fixed-curriculum-plus-SLEEP canary. V2_ES11_ADAPTIVE_PACKAGE_ACCELERATION: root-assigned birth-by-adaptive-parent cells require equal nonparent opportunity, complete parent information/effort receipts, terminal standardized panels/exams, Delta_E at least +0.03 on both roots, and the ecological package label only. V2_ES12_REPETITION_ENACTMENT_FADE_AND_RELAPSE: immutable lesson fixtures must distinguish relevant uncued action change from irrelevant ritual use and verify reset persistence; fixed reminders never adapt, while only adaptive reminders follow frozen acquisition/fade/relapse/restoration rules. V2_ES13_STORAGE_EXTRACTION_USE_AND_CONTROLS: separately freeze and score source reproduction, held-out extraction, and fresh native use after reset; each semantic/provenance control needs a preregistered disappearance, reversal, or action-redirection prediction under matched opportunity, and evaluation or retrieval leakage fails the claim. V2_ES14_PERSONAL_REPLAY_DEPENDENCE: immediately probe one admitted personal sentinel, then compare disposable same-birth cumulative and full sentinel-descendant ablation candidates without lineage feedback; report only replay dependence, preserve the previous-child baseline, and require an explicit equal-dose rule that does not reintroduce the removed semantic closure. V2_ES15_RANK_BY_EXPOSURE_ONLY: cross rank 8/16 with low/high supervised exposure after compiler selection while holding alpha/r, modules, roots, writer, and evaluation fixed; report only compiler-conditional capacity-by-exposure and engineering measures. V2_ES16_CADENCE_TOTAL_AND_STANDARDIZED_LEDGER: after new authority, K4-K1 natural lives estimate the total cadence package, common-writer terminal rewrites estimate standardized-ledger consequences, and within-ledger comparisons remain descriptive; no mediation label is permitted. V2_ES17_PRIMARY_STATISTICS_AND_SPEND_ORDER: freeze Y as engine-recorded success within budget, failures as zero, ages 0/8/16/24/32, the stated normalized trapezoid AUC, margins, safety comparators, root allocation, one mixed-sign rerun, six-new-root analysis, intervals, and multiplicity before generation; never treat tasks, ages, seeds, or canaries as independent confirmation. V3_ES19_EVALUATION_PRODUCT_NONINTERFERENCE: taint every exam observation, transcript, score, cache, and report and prove only reporting/audit roots change, with no dependency on them from the continuing child, parent, evidence, repetition, compiler, or lineage. V3_ES20_REJECTED_SLEEP_PRESERVES_LIFE: commit distinctive life/parent/repetition sentinels, fail each candidate gate, restart, and show prior active weights plus all legitimate pre-SLEEP state survive into the next admissible candidate while every failed view/corpus/adapter/evaluation stays quarantined. V2_ES18_FRESH_REVIEW_AND_GPU_GATE: after separately authorized implementation and cheapest preflight, a fresh independent reviewer may veto, an author advocate cannot override, and only explicit human authorization of the exact GPU packet permits execution.
assumptions: T and D are immutable births made from the same exact M0, and bootstrap causal statements are incremental T-versus-D contrasts unless M0 is explicitly named.

Every personal replacement adapter is trained fresh from its assigned immutable birth and cumulative committed personal corpus; the prior personal adapter is only a state comparator, never a weight initializer.
Curriculum roots are the independent assignment and inference units; tasks, advice items, ages, rows, and seeds are repeated measurements.
All advice clones and examination clones are disposable and cannot write, update a parent, affect selection, enter any life ledger, or alter a continuing lineage.
The fixed-policy assay includes personal SLEEP as part of the developmental regime, whereas the immediate standardized-advice assay excludes it.
Candidate microdomains are not called unrelated until exact source and structural audits pass; target blindness means incremental construction nondependence only.

The direct-solution control differs irreducibly in conditional information and cognitive work; pairing, dose balance, calibration, and M0 safety bound shortcuts but do not create semantic equivalence.
At least six new roots are only a minimum replication condition; exact inference, multiplicity, construct, preservation, noninterference, review, and human claim gates remain necessary.

ambiguities.question: Can the SLEEP transaction inspect only equality/membership of a parent-message exclusion ID, or may the ID, parent-root metadata, ordering, or counts enter compiler selection, rendering, caching, or dose decisions?
ambiguities.impact: An opaque but treatment-correlated identifier is still an information channel; if it affects the personal corpus or gradients, the proposal recreates parent-conditioned personal training despite excluding prose bytes.

ambiguities.question: What exact arm-independent material replaces sentinel and descendant exposures in the fully ablated V2_ES14 candidate so supervised-token/update dose stays equal without restoring their semantics?
ambiguities.impact: Removing an entire descendant closure changes semantic content and optimizer opportunity; without a frozen replacement rule the cumulative-minus-ablated contrast mixes replay dependence with generic dose and corpus-composition effects.

ambiguities.question: What mechanical rule marks descendants, paraphrases, correlated cues, and support bundles of a personal sentinel, and how are validator disagreements resolved before the ablation?
ambiguities.impact: Under-removal leaves a covert replay path, while over-removal deletes independent later experience and broadens the estimand from sentinel replay dependence to removal of a larger life-history component.

ambiguities.question: What exact within-root allocation, blocking, entry normalization, safety comparator, confidence interval, multiplicity, early-termination, and positive-but-submargin disposition applies to Delta_R, Delta_F, and Delta_E?
ambiguities.impact: The frozen score, ages, margins, and root count do not alone determine unbiased assignment or a reproducible scientific decision, and the -0.05 bound refers to several different safety estimands.

ambiguities.question: Which compiler factors, cue families, identity splits, prompt surfaces, aggregation rules, and practical margins instantiate the writer factorial required for C_EXPERIENCE_EXTRACTABLE_AND_USABLE?
ambiguities.impact: V2_ES13 names the constructs and controls but not the exact intervention or scoring surface, leaving recital, generalization, and native use vulnerable to post-hoc redefinition.

ambiguities.question: How will the frozen six-computation rubric distinguish supplied-action execution from computation 3 or 6, and what quantitative M0 calibration threshold makes D grossly easier or invalid?
ambiguities.impact: A circular 100%-T/0%-D rubric can define arm membership into the manipulation check, while an unfrozen difficulty rule permits outcome-informed control repair.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: Allowing a non-dereferenceable parent-message exclusion ID or reading the restricted parent-state root inside SLEEP is safe only if those values are causally inert to compiler and writer outputs, not merely text-free.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: Identifiers, ordering, counts, and hashes can proxy parent condition, lesson, timing, or child history and can influence selection, cache keys, batch construction, or gradients even when raw prose cannot be recovered.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Move the exclusion proof to an audit sidecar outside the semantic compiler DAG, or freeze an interface whose only operation is validation and require output-invariance/taint tests under ID renaming, reordering, and parent-root mutation.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: V2_ES14 cannot attribute the cumulative-versus-ablated difference specifically to replay dependence while simultaneously removing an unconstrained descendant closure and merely asserting equal dose.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: The intended intervention necessarily changes training content; if it also reduces target tokens, updates, lesson coverage, or difficulty, the contrast includes generic dose and corpus-composition effects. If replacement examples are chosen after inspecting behavior, the control is outcome-dependent.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Before generation, define the descendant closure and a prospective neutral replacement/exposure-matching rule, report both the total closure-removal effect and any dose-standardized sensitivity analysis, and keep the claim limited to dependence on the replayed sentinel closure.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The v3 human decision question asks whether Rohin ratifies the exact v2 architecture, which is inconsistent with the v3 change ID and title.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: Exact-byte authority cannot rely on an ambiguous version label, especially when v3 exists specifically because v2 was adjudicated rework and contains five rejected proposal-byte blockers.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Before ratification, issue new exact proposal bytes whose decision question names chg_20260909_extractable_sleep_bootstrap_v3 and explicitly states that the rejected v2 bytes are not being ratified; rerun the required exact-byte deliberation.

open_questions: Will Rohin require correction of the human decision question so it unambiguously names the exact v3 change ID and bytes rather than the rejected v2 architecture?

Will the parent exclusion ID and restricted parent root be kept outside all semantic compiler, renderer, cache, dose, and gradient decisions, with a taint/invariance test proving they cannot act as proxies?
What exact descendant-closure and equal-dose replacement rules should govern the personal replay-dependence assay before any corpus or benchmark generation?

Before generation or model execution, what exact writer factorial, Delta_R endpoint, allocation, entry-normalization, safety estimands, intervals, multiplicity, structural-overlap rule, and direct-control difficulty threshold will be frozen?

Does Rohin accept the narrow estimands and claims: immediate T-versus-D advice use for Delta_R, fixed-curriculum-plus-personal-SLEEP development for Delta_F, adaptive parent+child+SLEEP package interaction for Delta_E, replay dependence rather than unreplayed retention, noncausal repetition absent randomization, and total-package cadence rather than mediation?

Will all implementation, tokenizer/model execution, benchmark generation, adapter/checkpoint work, GPU/resource use, external scientific execution, publication, push, and scientific claims remain forbidden until their separately bound exact gates and human decisions pass?
